entities.summary: Andre Riddick is a retired American professional basketball player. He is the ULEB Cup's All-Time Leader for rebounds (383), steals (116) and blocks (122) and also has the highest ULEB Cup percentage of blocks. He played for the University of Kentucky from 1991 to 1995.
